defuss-shadcn / Website / website-events-promotions

Events & Promotions

Blocks for campaigns, events and places: calls to action, announcements, offers and countdowns, bookings, event listings and pages - header, description, speakers, sessions and registration - and locations with maps, a store finder and opening hours. Every block is CSS-only and built from the library's components and tokens.

On this page (3)
The templateAn event pageThe blocks

§The template

The Events & Promotions blocks composed into one page - the source is the page.

§An event page

An announcement, the Event Header, the Summit Night scene - seven parallax planes, scroll slowly -, a Countdown bar, the Event Description, the agenda (Session Items), the speakers, the venue (Location Map + Opening Hours) and a final CTA - only Events & Promotions blocks.

×%

§The blocks

CTA

Combines a focused message with a prominent action - centered, split, on a dark glow or over a picture.

Announcement

Highlights an important update with an optional link or dismissal - a bar, a filled strip, an inline card or a floating notice.

Offer Banner

Presents a promotion with its conditions and action - a gradient card, a slim ribbon or a coupon with a tear-off edge.

Event Countdown

Displays the remaining time until a specified event - days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking down beside the date and the action.

Booking Form

Collects a service selection, available slot, and customer details - radio cards, a native date, time chips and the contact fields.

Event Item

Previews one event with its date, location, and attendance link - a calendar tile, the title, time and place, and a register action.

Event Header

Introduces an event with its title, date, venue, and primary action - on a gradient band, over a cover picture, or beside a poster.

Event Description

Explains an event's purpose, audience, and participation details - the story, who it is for, what you take away, and the practical facts.

Speaker Item

Introduces one speaker with a portrait, role, and biography - with their talk, as a card, a featured keynote or a compact row.

Session Item

Presents one scheduled session with its time, topic, and speakers - with its track, room and an "add to my schedule" toggle; breaks and keynotes styled apart.

Registration Form

Collects attendee information and event participation choices - the ticket, the attendee, the workshops and the practical needs.

Location Item

Presents one physical location with its address and directions - the address, whether it is open now, the phone and a directions link.

Location Map

Displays one or more locations on an interactive map - pins open a card anchored to them, a list beside the map names every place.

Locator Search

Finds nearby locations using an address or current position - a search with "use my location", a radius and the results.

Opening Hours

Displays operating hours and date-specific exceptions - the week with today marked, whether it is open now, and the holidays.
